summary.text: Steve Stafstrom represents the Bridgeport neighborhoods of Black Rock, Brooklawn and the West End in the Connecticut House of Representatives and was first elected in a 2015 special election.

paragraphs.text: He is House Chair of the Judiciary Committee and also serves on the Finance, Revenue and Bonding Committee.

Stafstrom attended public schools in Orange, earned an undergraduate degree from Fairfield University and a law degree from Saint Louis University School of Law, and formerly served on the Bridgeport City Council.
He is a member of the Bridgeport-based law firm Pullman & Comley, LLC, and lives in Black Rock.
